ws_enrollment_rules.title: Enrollment Rules
values: Do not enroll contacts from Healthcare or Government industry accounts
If an account's parent company is in a restricted industry, the subsidiary is also restricted regardless of its own industry classification
Only enroll contacts with 'Director' in their title. 'Associate Director' and 'Director Emeritus' are not eligible.
Before enrolling any contact, check their record and their account record for compliance notes, opt-out requests, or outreach holds. Honor all restrictions found in record descriptions.
